title: Wrap-up: board of directors, no thought of playing again
summary: Scott says his main interest is the Amsterdam.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Is there anything else you can think of that you think (inaudible). I guess we've pretty well covered your career.

Yes, I think we have. And right now, my main interest is the Amsterdam Club, and I'd like sometime to have you up there when we have a particular night, as a guest, and I'm on the board of directors there now. I didn't want to be on there, but they put me on, they made me get on it.
Most of these fellows that you see there, I have checked and played with, they're around my age, and they're all gone. And God has spared me to still be here, and I'm in a lost

world, but I'm so thankful and grateful that I'm able to get around on my own. And I have some contact with music. But I never think about playing again, now. What would happen to me in a band now? And all these young fellows. Those young fellows are so lively and young, they can play all night long. I couldn't do it anymore.
